<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Flex Box Container</title>
    <style>
        .home-contact-container {
            padding: 10px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin: 5px;
            border: 3px solid green;
        }

        .left-container {
            width: 49%;
            height: 500px;
            border: 3px solid blue;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .right-container {
            width: 49%;
            height: 500px;
            border: 3px solid red;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-around;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .side-containers {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            border: 3px solid black;
            margin: 5px;
            padding: 10px;
        }

        .footer-container {
            width: 100%;
            height: 50px;
            border: 3px solid gray;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: left;
            align-items: center;
            margin: 5px;
        }

    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="home-contact-container">
        <a href="#Home">Home</a>
        <a href="#">Contact</a>
    </div>

    <div class="side-containers">
        <div class="left-container">
            <h1>Left</h1>
        </div>

        <div class="right-container">
            <h1>Right</h1>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-container">
        <p>Footer Content</p>
    </div>

</body>
</html>
